title: 第5章 生死印，皇子拜师
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
道法自然功乃修仙功法，虽然姜长生目前练出来的也是真气，但道法自然，此功讲究的就是与自然合一，所以他的真气气息是武夫无法窥探的，最多感受到他身怀真气，一丝淡薄的真气。
姜渊望着亭前跪拜的姜长生，一阵恍惚，他感慨道：“朕听陈礼说过，小道士，你如此年少便有卓越的武功，可见天资不凡，大景就需要你这样的天才。”
姜长生回道：“多谢陛下夸奖。”
原来是陈礼说了好话，陈礼已经不止一次建议他去考武状元，虽不知他有多强，但十二岁的他惊艳了陈礼。
姜渊笑了笑，抬步继续离去。
姜长生垂着头，他心里有站起来认亲的冲动，但理智告诉他，时机还不够，太危险了。
一别十数年，如何认亲，难道靠滴血认亲？
就算成功，皇宫里的争斗可不少，而且他一旦显露真实身份，姜渊暴怒，杀孽过多，为他惹来的仇恨便越多，他回到皇宫，又该如何自处？
每日都得提心吊胆，还如何修炼？
先得有无惧任何危险的实力才能显露自己的真实身份！
姜长生忽然感受到一道目光，他不用抬头便能感知到是那位老太监。
龙起观内有奸细，老太监自然知晓他的身份。
这道目光没有停留太久，待他们远去后，姜长生等人方才起身。
孟秋河兴奋道：“可以啊，长生师弟，连陛下都
其他同门弟子也很激动，女弟子们看向他的目光充满异彩，花季年纪，少女难免怀春，更何况姜长生的俊秀在龙起观内可谓是一枝独秀。
姜长生摇头失笑道：“没什么用，说不定还有麻烦呢，我先退下了，你们继续聊。”
说罢，他自顾自的离去。
孟秋河没有阻拦，而是在思索一个问题。
长生师弟如今有多强？
得找个机会切磋一下。

回到屋内，姜长生打坐在床榻上练功，道法自然功博大精深，他也不清楚具体有多少层，只要练成功后，才会解锁下一层的记忆。
一直到夜晚，青苦方才回来。
自从经历过江湖后，青苦便沉默寡言，平日里沉浸于武学之中，面貌气质看起来比实际年龄要成熟。
青苦看了姜长生一眼，也没有多说，同样在床榻上打坐练功。
数日后。
陈礼再次前来拜访姜长生。
道钟旁，陈礼兴奋道：“可以啊，长生，陛下竟然夸奖你，昨日早朝，陛下提了大景武道，希望能吸纳武林人士考取武状元，入伍参军，还特地提了你一句，说龙起观内有一名少年道士，十四岁便有一流高手的实力。”
“怎么样，去考武状元吗，有陛下这句话，没有人会给你上手段，只要你武功够强，便能畅通无阻。”
姜长生摇头道：“我的武功还不够强，而且我还年少，不适合太早入世。”
陈礼愣了愣，感慨道：“长生，你小小年纪却有远见，看破红尘，我都怀疑你是不是神仙下凡。”
他从未见过如此沉稳的少年郎，即便面对天大的好处，也不心动。
旋即他转移话题，道：“你们大师兄在江湖上已经闯出名声，不过他身陷麻烦，清虚道长今日已下山。”
闻言，姜长生睁眼。
大师兄李长青在龙起观如同大家长，虽是武痴，但性情温和，对年幼弟子多有照顾，姜长生对其也充满好感。
他好奇问道：“什么麻烦？”
陈礼无奈道：“自然是儿女情长，他不知怎的与魔门女子搭上关系，被魔门抓走，魔门放话，清虚道长得亲自前去捞人。”
姜长生皱眉。
他的第一反应是有诈！
不会是哪些权贵勾结魔门所为，把清虚道长支走，龙起观便没了高手，就可以对他下手？
不排除这个可能，即便是巧合，那些家伙也不会放过这个机会。

自姜长生来到龙起观，清虚道长还未下山过，此番下山对于那些权贵而言，乃是千载难逢的机会。
姜长生没有慌乱，光论体内真气，他已经比清虚道长强大数倍，又掌握武学，只是没有实战经验，到时候小心点便是，毕竟这里是京城，对方应该不敢大张旗鼓。
陈礼继续说李长青之事，李长青带着同门弟子行走江湖，行侠仗义，偶然救了一名女子，那女子投怀送抱，后才知晓其身份乃是魔门弟子，还是门主之女，地位特殊，那女子誓要嫁于李长青，此事在江湖上已经传开，甚至传到京城客栈内。
龙起观是唯一一座立于京城的门派，在江湖上地位特殊，事关龙起观，江湖儿郎自然感到新鲜。
陈礼说了半个时辰，留下一包药材方才离去。
此药材适合习武之人服用，十分珍贵，千金难求。
姜长生望着他离去的背影，默默记下这份情，然后开始思考接下来如何面对可能出现的敌袭。
清虚道长离去后，二师兄孟秋河当家做主，当夜，龙起观鸡飞狗跳，迎来十数年难遇的热闹之夜，弟子们欢腾，好生喧哗。
姜长生在屋内练功，被扰得心乱，但又不好意思出去喝止。
姜长生睁开眼睛，他眯眼，暗道：“这么着急吗？”
他感受到屋檐上有人的气息，爬行过程之中没有发出任何声音，换做寻常武夫，可能根本察觉不到。
没过多久，一股奇异的香味从上方蔓延而下。
姜长生立即屏息，道法自然功乃修仙功法，他可以屏息半个时辰，远超寻常人。
半柱香时间后，他佯装瘫倒在床上。
一道身影从窗户外跃进来，这名刺客竟是一名龙起观弟子，二十岁出头，面容普通，很不出众，他盯着床榻上的姜长生，暗道：“这家伙的功力竟然如此高，撑了这么久。”
他从袖中拔出一把匕首，小心翼翼来到床边，然后朝着姜长生的胸口刺去。
就在这时，姜长生的双腿忽然抬起，绞住刺客的手臂，他往后翻跟头，顺势将刺客掀起来，砸在床榻上。
这一连串的动作实在是太快，还未等刺客反应，姜长生坐在他身上，将他擒住。
刺客催动真气，想要震退姜长生，但惊恐地发现自己根本震不开。
“好可怕的功力，这小子绝对在一流之上！”

刺客心中惊骇，双目瞪得老大。
姜长生看清对方的真容，幽幽道：“五师兄，你这是作甚？”
刺客猛地咬牙，嘴里溢出鲜血，竟服毒自杀。
姜长生来不及阻止，也没有失望。
他从刺客身上摸索了一番，什么都没有摸到，他跟着大声喊道：“有刺客！”
他连吼十几声，青苦率先冲进来，紧接着是其他弟子。
姜长生瘫坐在床上，大口喘气，一脸惊魂未定的神色。
孟秋河从人群中挤开，迅速上前，当他看到死者时，他脸色大变：“五师弟！”
其他弟子也大惊。
五师兄的存在感虽不高，但平时也没有跟其他弟子结仇。
孟秋河注意到刺客手中的匕首，脸色阴沉下来，他上前检查，很快便得出结论：“服毒自杀。”
他瞬间意识到事情的严重性，若是同门矛盾，何必在嘴里藏毒？
他看向姜长生，希望姜长生能说点什么。
姜长生故作惊怒，咬牙道：“我也不知道五师兄为何要袭击我，他想杀我，被我反擒住，然后就服毒自杀。”
这里是他的房间，他有底气。
青苦跟着道：“长生师兄平日里都独自练功，跟其他弟子都没有仇恨，就算有仇，五师兄跑到我们房间行刺也不对啊，而且他服毒自杀，明显心里有鬼，怕被问出来什么。”
其他弟子点头，纷纷发表意见，也有人质疑姜长生，毕竟死者为大。
孟秋河深吸一口气，道：“长生师弟，今日起，你就待在房间里，青苦负责送饭菜，一直等到师父回来，庭院弟子轮流守着，保护长生师弟。”
姜长生没有意见，说是保护，其实也有监守的意思，毕竟谁也不清楚真相。
孟秋河带人将刺客尸体带出去。

青苦安慰道：“长生师兄，你别怕，我会一直守在外面。”
姜长生点头，目送他离去。
此事让龙起观的热闹消停，又陷入以往的沉寂中。
姜长生听到许多弟子在讨论此事，弟子们都觉得蹊跷，五师兄为何要杀姜长生？
姜长生重新打坐，开始练功。
他心里开始盘算对方之后会派来怎样的高手。
【开元十四年，刺客袭击你，被你擒获，刺客服毒自杀，你度过一场杀祸，获得生存奖励——武学‘生死印’】
一行提示出现在他眼前，趁着弟子们还在外面，他立即接受生死印的传承。
生死印是一种真气武学，可打出一道印记，印在敌人的经脉穴道上，让对方生不如死，是一种折磨型武学，不致命，但催命。
这武学好，要是再抓到敌人，可以拷问。
不过姜长生很清楚敌人有哪些，暂时用不上，多学一道武学，以后总归有用处。
接下来十日，姜长生没有遭遇袭击，或许是因为庭院内有弟子轮流镇守，敌人不敢轻举妄动。
这一日正午。
庭院内响起喧哗之声。
“大胆！本殿下想见人，你们还不允许？”
“不敢不敢，只是……”
“只是什么？”
“长生师弟先前被刺客袭击，我们在保护他……”
“放肆，你活腻了？你觉得本殿下要杀他？”
一番喧闹后，房门被蛮横推开，一名衣着华贵的少年气冲冲的跑进来，看起来只有十一二岁，身后是两名紫衣男子，身形魁梧，各握一把佩刀。

少年见到姜长生，眼睛一亮，立即冲过来，兴奋道：“可是长生道士？”
姜长生的姓氏只有自己知晓，他平日里以长生居之。
姜长生走下床榻，拱手问道：“不知施主是……”
少年得意笑道：“我乃四皇子，特来拜师学武。”
姜长生诧异问道：“为何找我？”
四皇子瞥了后面两位侍卫一眼，两人立即后退，退到房门前，四皇子上前一步，凑到姜长生面前，低声道：“父皇说你很厉害，让我来拜师，可有其他皇子找过你？”
content_en:
The Taoist Natural Technique is an immortal cultivation technique. Although Jiang Changsheng is currently practicing true energy, the Taoist Natural Technique emphasizes being one with nature. Therefore, his true energy breath cannot be spied by a martial artist. At most, he can feel the true energy in his body, a faint trace of true energy.
Jiang Yuan looked at Jiang Changsheng who was kneeling in front of the pavilion. He felt dazed for a while and said with emotion: "I heard Chen Li say, little Taoist priest, you have outstanding martial arts at such a young age, which shows that you have extraordinary talents. The big scene needs a genius like you."
Jiang Changsheng replied: "Thank you for the compliment, Your Majesty."
It turned out that it was Chen Li who put in good words. Chen Li had suggested more than once that he should take the martial arts exam. Although he didn't know how strong he was, the twelve-year-old Chen Li was amazed by him.
Jiang Yuan smiled and continued to leave.
Jiang Changsheng lowered his head. He had the urge to stand up and recognize his relatives, but his reason told him that the time was not enough and it was too dangerous.
After more than ten years of separation, how can we recognize our relatives? Is it possible to recognize relatives through a drop of blood?
Even if he succeeds, there will be a lot of fights in the palace, and once his true identity is revealed, Jiang Yuan will be furious and kill too many evildoers, which will arouse more hatred for him. How should he deal with himself when he returns to the palace?
How can I practice when I have to be on tenterhooks every day?
You must first have the strength to be unafraid of any danger before you can reveal your true identity!
Jiang Changsheng suddenly felt a gaze, and he could tell it was the old eunuch without raising his head.
There is a spy in Longqi Temple, and the old eunuch naturally knows his identity.
This gaze did not stay for long. After they left, Jiang Changsheng and others stood up.
Meng Qiuhe said excitedly: "Yes, Junior Brother Changsheng, even His Majesty
The other disciples were also very excited. The female disciples looked at him with extraordinary eyes. It is inevitable for a girl to be pregnant at her young age, not to mention that Jiang Changsheng's handsomeness can be said to be unique in Longqi Temple.
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and laughed: "It's useless, there might be trouble, I'll leave now, you can continue talking. "
After that, he left to his own devices.
Meng Qiuhe did not stop him, but was thinking about a question.
How strong is Junior Brother Changsheng now?
We need to find an opportunity to discuss it.
Back in the house, Jiang Changsheng meditated on the bed and practiced the exercises. The Taoist skills were naturally profound and profound, and he didn't know exactly how many levels there were. Only after successful practice would the next level of memory be unlocked.
It wasn't until night that Qing Ku came back.
Since his experience in the martial arts world, Qing Ku has been silent and immersed in martial arts. His appearance and temperament look more mature than his actual age.
Qing Ku glanced at Jiang Changsheng, didn't say much, and also meditated on the bed.
A few days later.
Chen Li came to visit Jiang Changsheng again.
Beside the Taoist bell, Chen Li said excitedly: "Yes, Changsheng, His Majesty actually praised you. Yesterday morning, His Majesty mentioned Dajing Martial Arts, hoping to attract martial arts people to pass the martial arts championship and join the army. He also specifically mentioned it to you, saying that there is a young Taoist priest in Longqi Temple who has the strength of a first-class master at the age of fourteen. "
"How about it, are you going to take the martial arts exam? As your Majesty says, no one will give you any tricks. As long as your martial arts skills are strong enough, you will be able to succeed without any hindrance. "
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and said: "My martial arts are not strong enough, and I am still young and not suitable for entering the world too early. "
Chen Li was stunned for a moment and said with emotion: "Chang Sheng, you are far-sighted at such a young age, and you can see through the world of mortals. I even doubt whether you are a god descended to earth. "
He has never seen such a calm young man, even in the face of huge benefits, he is not moved.
He immediately changed the subject and said: "Your senior brother has already made a name for himself in the world, but he is in trouble. Taoist Master Qingxu has left the mountain today. "
Hearing this, Jiang Changsheng opened his eyes.
Senior Brother Li Changqing is like a patriarch in Longqi Temple. Although he is a martial arts fanatic, he has a gentle temperament and takes good care of his younger disciples. Jiang Changsheng also has a good impression of him.
He asked curiously: "What's the trouble? "
Chen Li said helplessly: "It's natural that children love each other. He doesn't know why."He got into a relationship with a girl from the Demon Sect and was kidnapped by the Demon Sect. The Demon Sect told him that Taoist priest Qingxu had to go to get her in person. "
Jiang Changsheng frowned.
His first reaction was that it was a scam!
Could it be that some powerful people colluded with the Demon Sect to send Taoist Master Qingxu away, so that Long Qiguan would have no masters and could attack him?
This possibility cannot be ruled out, even if it is a coincidence, those guys will not let go of this opportunity.
Since Jiang Changsheng came to Longqi Temple, Taoist Master Qingxu has not yet gone down the mountain. This trip down the mountain is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for those powerful people.
Jiang Changsheng did not panic. In terms of the true energy in his body, he was already several times stronger than Taoist Master Qingxu. He also mastered martial arts. He just had no actual combat experience. Just be careful when the time comes. After all, this is the capital, and the opponent should not dare to make a big show of it.
Chen Li continued to talk about Li Changqing. Li Changqing traveled around the world with his fellow disciples, acted chivalrously, and accidentally saved a woman. The woman threw herself into his arms, and only later did she find out that she was a disciple of the Demon Sect, or the daughter of the sect leader. She had a special status. The woman vowed to marry Li Changqing. This matter had spread in the world, and even reached the inn in the capital.
Longqiguan is the only sect established in the capital, and it has a special status in the world. It is natural for Jianghu Erlang to feel fresh about Longqiguan.
Chen Li talked for half an hour, leaving a bag of medicinal materials before leaving.
This medicinal material is suitable for people who practice martial arts. It is very precious and hard to find.
Jiang Changsheng looked at his leaving back, silently recorded this feeling, and then began to think about how to face possible enemy attacks next.
After Taoist Master Qingxu left, the second senior brother Meng Qiuhe took charge of the family. That night, the dragons rose up to watch the chickens and dogs jumping, ushering in a lively night that had not been seen in more than ten years. The disciples were jubilant and noisy.
Jiang Changsheng was practicing in the house and was disturbed, but he was too embarrassed to go out to drink.
Jiang Changsheng opened his eyes, squinted and said secretly: "Are you so anxious? "
He felt the breath of someone on the eaves, but he made no sound while crawling. An ordinary martial artist might not be able to detect it at all.
Not long after, a strange fragrance spread from above.
Jiang Changsheng immediately held his breath. The Taoist natural technique was a cultivation technique. He could hold his breath for half an hour, which was far superior to ordinary people.
After half a stick of incense, he pretended to collapse on the bed.
A figure jumped in from the window. This assassin turned out to be a disciple of Long Qiguan. He was in his early twenties and had an ordinary face. He stared at Jiang Changsheng on the bed and said to himself: "This guy's skill is so high that he has lasted for so long. "
He pulled out a dagger from his sleeve, carefully came to the bedside, and then stabbed Jiang Changsheng in the chest.
At this moment, Jiang Changsheng's legs suddenly lifted up, twisting the assassin's arm. He somersaulted backwards, lifted the assassin up, and smashed him onto the bed.
This series of movements was too fast. Before the assassin could react, Jiang Changsheng sat on him and captured him.
The assassin activated his true energy and tried to repel Jiang Changsheng, but was horrified to find that he could not do so at all.
"What a terrifying skill, this kid is definitely above the rest! "
The assassin was horrified and his eyes widened.
Jiang Changsheng saw the other party's true appearance clearly and said quietly: "Fifth Senior Brother, what are you doing? "
The assassin gritted his teeth violently, blood spilled from his mouth, and he committed suicide by taking poison.
Jiang Changsheng had no time to stop him and was not disappointed.
He groped for a while from the assassin, but found nothing, so he shouted loudly: "There is an assassin! "
He roared more than a dozen times, and Qing Ku rushed in first, followed closely by the other disciples.
Jiang Changsheng sat slumped on the bed, gasping for air with a look of shock on his face.
Meng Qiuhe squeezed away from the crowd and stepped forward quickly. When he saw the deceased, his expression changed drastically: "Fifth Junior Brother! "
The other disciples were also shocked.
Although the fifth senior brother's presence is not high, he usually does not have any enmity with other disciples.
Meng Qiuhe noticed the dagger in the assassin's hand and his face darkened., he stepped forward to check and quickly came to the conclusion: "Suicide by taking poison."
He instantly realized the seriousness of the matter. If they were in conflict with each other, why would they hide poison in their mouths?
He looked at Jiang Changsheng, hoping Jiang Changsheng could say something.
Jiang Changsheng pretended to be frightened and angry, and gritted his teeth and said: "I don't know why the fifth senior brother attacked me. He wanted to kill me, but I captured him and then committed suicide by taking poison."
This is his room, and he is confident.
Qing Ku followed: "Senior Brother Changsheng practices alone on weekdays and has no enmity with other disciples. Even if he had enmity, it would not be right for Fifth Senior Brother to come to our room and assassinate us. Moreover, he committed suicide by taking poison. He obviously had something in his heart and was afraid of being asked."
Other disciples nodded and expressed their opinions one after another. Some people questioned Jiang Changsheng. After all, the dead person was the most important.
Meng Qiuhe took a deep breath and said: "Junior Brother Changsheng, from today on, you will stay in the room. Qing Ku will be responsible for delivering the food until Master comes back. The disciples in the courtyard will take turns guarding to protect Junior Brother Changsheng."
Jiang Changsheng had no objection. He said it was for protection, but in fact it also meant to guard him. After all, no one knew the truth.
Meng Qiuhe led people to take the assassin's body out.
Qing Ku comforted him: "Senior Brother Changsheng, don't be afraid, I will always stay outside."
Jiang Changsheng nodded and watched him leave.
This incident caused the liveliness of Long Qiguan to subside and fell into the silence of the past.
Jiang Changsheng heard many disciples discussing this matter. The disciples all felt strange. Why did the fifth senior brother want to kill Jiang Changsheng?
Jiang Changsheng meditated again and started practicing.
He began to think about what kind of master the other party would send in the future.
[In the fourteenth year of Kaiyuan, an assassin attacked you and was captured by you. The assassin committed suicide by taking poison. You survived the murder and received a survival reward - the martial arts 'Seal of Life and Death']
A line of prompts appeared in front of him. While the disciples were still outside, he immediately accepted the inheritance of the Seal of Life and Death.
The Seal of Life and Death is a kind of Zhenqi martial arts. It can create a mark on the enemy's meridians and acupuncture points, making the opponent's life worse than death. It is a torture type of martial arts, not fatal, but life-threatening.
If you are good at this martial arts, if you catch the enemy again, you can torture him.
However, Jiang Changsheng knew very well who his enemies were, so he wouldn't be able to use them for the time being. Learning more martial arts would be useful in the future.
